'''Spring''' can refer to the following:

==Locations==
* [[Alianelle Spring]] - an oasis between [[Cairhien]] and [[Tar Valon]].
* [[Breen's Spring]] - a village on the [[Caemlyn Road]] in [[Andor]].
* [[Ionin Spring]] - a village in [[Altara]].
* [[Ionin Spring Inn]] - an inn in a village by the same name.
* [[Kore Springs]] - a town in northern Andor.
* The [[Winespring]] - a natural aquifier in [[Emond's Field]]
* The [[Winespring Water]] - a creek in the [[Two Rivers]], originating in Emond's Field.
* [[The Winespring Inn]] - an inn in Emond's Field.

==Aiel holds==
* [[Hot Springs Hold]] - the clan hold of the [[Shaarad]] [[Aiel]].
* [[Red Springs Hold]] - the clan hold of the [[Codarra]] Aiel.
* [[Smoke Springs Hold]] - the clan hold of the [[Goshien]] Aiel.

==Book and chapter titles==
* ''[[New Spring]]'' - the prequel novel of ''[[The Wheel of Time]]'' series.
* The [[New Spring comic|''New Spring'' comic]] - an adaptation of the prequel novel.
* ''[[The Dragon Reborn/Chapter 29]]'' - the twenty-ninthe chapter of ''[[The Dragon Reborn]]''.

==Others==
* [[The Lion Springs]] - a [[sword form]].
* [[Springhorn]] - a packleader wolf.
* The [[Spring Pole]] - a part of the [[Bel Tine]] festival.
